data.name: Extinct Forest
data.detailed_description:
Extinct Forest is a hardcore, physics‑driven FPS set in a vast, abandoned wilderness. There are no crosshairs, no traditional HUD, and no weapon reloading — just you, your limited tools and predators that react to sight and sound. Every encounter is a risk, every shot a decision.

Explore forgotten facilities, solve environmental puzzles, and fight to stay alive in a world where preparation matters more than firepower.

Are you the hunter, or the prey?

CORE FEATURES

Pure immersion
Invisible UI, iron‑sights aiming, no traditional reloading, audio‑based shot awareness, and a visual health system. Weapons are limited‑use tools — when they’re empty, they’re discarded.

Smart predators
17 dinosaur species with distinct behaviors, including pack hunters, ambushers, and territorial giants. Featuring iconic species such as T. rex, Spinosaurus, and Giganotosaurus.

Exploration and puzzles
Navigate eerie locations and use physics to create openings, block paths, manipulate objects, or bait ambushes.

Dynamic world
Day/night cycles and dynamic weather that affect visibility, sound propagation, and predator behavior.

Performance options
High‑fidelity visuals with NVIDIA DLSS and AMD FSR support.

LOCATIONS

Available in Early Access
Diner • Pool • Military Outpost • Canyon • Industrial Area • Military Base

Planned during Early Access
Lake • Village • Hospital • Airport • Secret Area

data.short_description: Fight for your life in a mysterious, abandoned open world. In Extinct Forest, there are no crosshairs and no HUD — just you and your weapon against intelligent dinosaurs. Explore the desolate wilderness, solve environmental puzzles, and master realistic combat mechanics in this immersive shooter.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5700
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD required. DLSS/FSR supported.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD highly recommended for best experience.

content_descriptors.notes:
The developers describe the content like this:
This is a First-Person Survival game that focuses on combat against aggressive dinosaurs.
The game contains frequent violence and blood effects involving animals/creatures:

Players use firearms to defend themselves against dinosaurs.
Gunshots and attacks result in visible blood splatters on the enemies.
When the player takes damage (e.g., being bitten), blood droplets are displayed as an overlay on the screen to represent health status.

There are no human enemies to fight. The game does not contain any nudity, sexual content, or sexual violence.
